What type of currency accepted?

Q:

How can i set up an account?

loss of benefits.

Q:

What are the deposit and withdrawal limits?

A: The minimum deposit is AUD 10. The minimum withdraw is AUD 30. Withdrawal are limited to 5 times per day.

  • Withdrawals are limited to 5 times a day.

  • Max Payout for All Pokies Games AUD 100000.

Q:

Withdrawal Deadline for Winnings?

A: ✅ Yes.

Players must withdraw gameplay winnings within 7 days from the date they are won.

⏳ After 7 days, if no withdrawal is made, the system will automatically forfeit the winnings.

Q:

Can I top up if I still have balance??

A: To maintain clarity in bonus regulations, you must play and bet

your credit after each deposit. Once the credit are lower than AUD 1 or after

withdrawal, you may proceed with another deposit.

Q:

What is our ROLLOVER and TURNOVER?

Can I claim different bonus at the same time?
